title: Zombie Blood 100ml Shortfill 0mg (50VG/50PG)
description:
Zombie Blood offers a 100ml shortfill e-liquid with 0mg of nicotine. Balanced with a 50% VG/50% PG blend, Zombie Blood is perfect for sub-ohm vaping. Enjoy the intense flavour accents of high-quality food flavourings.
Zombie Blood Shortfill vape liquids come in many delicious flavours, including Apple Berry, Blackcurrant Menthol, and Menthol. With its 50/50 VG/PG blend, this 100ml bottle of 0mg nicotine provides a perfect balance of flavour and vapour. Perfect for any vaper who loves to explore new flavours.
100ml of E-Liquid
0mg Nicotine Strength
Room for Two 10ml Nic Shots
50VG / 50PG
Designed for Sub Ohm Vaping
Made in the UK
